description: The Brief's Go / No-Go put together, one call for every host that shows it: gonogo_verdict_items' seven findings, an oxygen finding after the altitude's where the nav log flies over 12,500 ft MSL in an airplane not known to carry oxygen or a pressurised cabin (14 CFR 91.211(a); a caution, its words then left out of the altitude's), the IFR alternate's finding in the weather's where the weather says nothing worse (gonogo_alternate_finding, 14 CFR 91.169(a), read only when verdict.weather.ifr), then the fields row for a closed, private or military-only field (gonogo_field_permission: decision 0043, 14 CFR 91.103), the fuel, runways and weight and balance left out where no airplane is picked (the owner, 2026-11-08: none is assumed), and the line over what is left (gonogo_verdict_line). The decision stays the pilot in command's (14 CFR 91.3).

alternate.description: /api/alternate's answer; null while it is awaited or where none was asked.

fields.description: The departure, the stops and the destination; null or empty where the route has no two ends yet.

items.description: The findings in the order the Brief shows them.
